author: Yffe
content: Failing test at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_byteview_collide_doubledef.rs (user_isdigit_plus_genuine_parse_use_no_double_def + user_countsep_plus_genuine_split_use_no_double_def) demonstrates the divergence. Forced (--ignored): 2 failed (lowering emits 2 definitions of is_digit / count_sep). Control arms (non-colliding names scan/piece) pass with exactly 1 generated def, so the divergence is the NAME COLLISION + genuine-use combination, not the generated emission. Test commit 4fe7df9. Root cause in thermite-lower/src/lower.rs: the shadow set suppresses the emission GATE only; it does not prevent the generated def-module (emitted by an independent non-shadowed trigger like parse_u64(s)/s.split(sep)) from materializing the collided name alongside the user spec fn. Authority: .design/basis/07-strings.md REQ-4 (SHAPE-keyed dispatch is collision-free).
